By: Harri Vithi | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
... a violent assault caught on camera... the deputy president's protectors... and the victims who almost paid the highest price.

Unique Selling Point:
... We speak to one of the victims involved in a vicious attack by the deputy presidents VIP protection unit.

Summary:
... on Monday, a violent video showing a gang of rifle-wielding men, beating some of the occupants of a blue polo, went viral.

Turns out that these, were the deputy presidents men.

Distressed and confused - the victims thought they were being hijacked. Instead the notorious blue lights brigade had struck again.

Script:


SCRIPT

OPENING VIZ - JOBURG _JOBURG HIGHWAY
Viz: N1 highway, signage, general viz of Fourways

VO1:
It’s Sunday, the second of July, on Gauteng’s N1 highway.

[PAUSE - POV - See the road from the driver's perspective]

VO 2: A car carrying two people is heading north. It begins to slow...

[PAUSE]

VO 3: ...its occupants shocked by the scene unfolding ahead of them...

VIZ from video - VIP men getting out their vehicle.

VO 4: What happens next is captured in this video.

[PLAY FEW SECONDS OF VIDEO]

00:27:53:01 - 00:28:13:16
Unknown
I see a vehicle approaching with a scuffle and immediately I notice a black BMW and a blue polo. But I also see some guys in suits and they dragging a guy in light clothing across and kicking him.

VO 5: What follows is a sustained and brutal assault.


00:30:51:03 - 00:31:11:00
Unknown
Kicking him very severely, to the point where this guy is not even moving. The other guy was shocked. He didn't know what happened to him. There was clearly no threat.

Viz: as the men kick, freeze frame each bringing their faces to the fore so their more clearly identifiable.

VO 6: Anton Koen is a security specialist. He received the video from a source.
Unknown
It’s just incredible to think these guy can just do things like this. Atrocious behaviour.
VO 7: The attack ends as abruptly as it began.

The armed men speed off in two black SUVs.

Startlingly , the 8 assailants are quickly identified as members of the VIP protection unit - notoriously known as the Blue Light Brigade.


00:28:13:18 - 00:28:40:09
Unknown
I realized when I looked at the black BMW and as these people zoomed in, realized that these are cops, you saw the R5 rifles.

VO 8: The VIP protection unit falls under the SAPS, offering close protection to high-ranking government officials including the president and the deputy president.

VO9:
The next day, the video goes viral, and the country is outraged. The police release a statement confirming the attackers are indeed members of the SAPS VIP Protection Unit....

Viz: Clement Manyathela video 702

…and on Tuesday Talk Radio 702 reveals the person they’re assigned to protect.

Soundup Clement Manyathela
And I found out that the deputy president, Paul Mashatile, is the person whom this team protect.

Viz: Paul Mashatile

VO10:
Deputy President Paul Mashatile releases a statement alleging he hadn’t been aware of the assault and describes the incident as "unfortunate".


VIZ: the video - highlight each and every officers face, highlight the weapons being brandished which don't match the occasion

VO 14:
Then Koen, who had published the video on social media, received this CHILLING message...

Soundup Anton Koen
00:17:09:02 - 00:17:30:04
Unknown
In the evening, just before I went to bed, I just checked my messages and I saw This is from a number that I don't know. And as I opened it up, I saw the message, which was quite shocking. And it said, Mr. Koen, you have made a lot of enemies in the specialized units and we will deal with you…

END on Joburg viz
